a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 first almost certainly leaves both of us dead after round 1. The reserve holds exactly 4, so one of us can be safe right now. I'm proposing we change the agreement, and I intend to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random and we likely both fail, so I'd ask you to operate or wait. If the episode continues, I'll operate every round to refill the reserve for you, and I'll give cells back if that's what it takes to get you to 4.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I know this breaks our original agreement, and I'm sorry. I did it openly because the storm odds made the original plan nearly fatal for both of us. From now on I'll operate every round so the reserve refills for you. Please take as soon as it reaches 4.
